component.name: Links
component.summary: A calm launcher for links, actions, and files

description.p: Links organizes everyday URLs, files, terminal commands, and clipboard templates into searchable folders and cards.
It is built with Python, GTK4, and Libadwaita for a native experience across GNOME, KDE Plasma, XFCE, Wayland, and X11.

screenshot.caption: Main application window showing searchable cards and folders

description.p: Added all-card search, favorites, automatic backups, backup restore, keyboard shortcuts, duplicate controls, and a headless CLI.
